translated_text: Heavenly gods, earthly gods, eight million deities! May the land be firm, the people at peace, the five grains abundant.
original_text: 天津神、國津神、八百萬の神々よ。國の固め、人の安けく、五穀豐かに。
title: Basic Norito (Shinto Prayer)
transliteration: Amatsukami, Kunitsukami, Yaoyorozu no Kamiyo! Kuni no katame, hito no yasuku, gokoku yutaka ni.

translated_text: The accumulated sins, the rooted sins, the sins of heaven, the sins of earth, ten sins, a hundred sins, a thousand sins, ten thousand sins — please remove them.
original_text: 荒びる罪、宿れる罪、天津の罪、國津の罪、十の罪、百の罪、千の罪、萬の罪を、除けたまへ。
title: Misogi (Purification) Prayer
transliteration: Aragiru tsumi, yadoreru tsumi, amatsu no tsumi, kunitsu no tsumi, to no tsumi, momo no tsumi, chi no tsumi, yorozu no tsumi wo, yoke tamae.

translated_text: As when the Heavenly Rock Cave was opened and the light of Amaterasu was beheld, may the dust of the heart be washed away.
original_text: 天の岩戸を開きて、天照大御神の御光を仰ぐが如く、心の塵を洗ひ給はん。
title: Mizuhiki (Water Ceremony) Prayer
transliteration: Ama no iwato wo hirakite, Amaterasu Omikami no mihikari wo aogu ga gotoku, kokoro no chiri wo aragihatan.

translated_text: The sacred rope is hung to mark a holy place and establish the seat of the gods.
original_text: 注連縄を打ちて、聖なる場所を定め、神の御座を定むるなり。
title: Shimenawa (Sacred Rope) Prayer
transliteration: Shimenawa wo uchite, sekinaru basho wo sadame, kami no mikado wo sadamuru nari.

translated_text: Visiting the shrine, washing hands, rinsing mouth, purifying heart, and paying respects to the gods.
original_text: 神宮に参りて、手を洗ひ、口を漱ぎ、心を清めて、神に参拝す。
title: O-mairabi (Shrine Visit) Prayer
transliteration: Jingu ni mairite, te wo arahi, kuchi wo sugi, kokoro wo kiyomete, kami ni sanpai su.

translated_text: At Ise Shrine, before Amaterasu, we offer words and present our sincere gratitude.
original_text: 伊勢の神宮に、天照大御神の御前に、詞を奉り、感謝の诚を捧ぐ。
title: Taisha (Great Shrine) Prayer
transliteration: Ise no Jingu ni, Amaterasu Omikami no mikono mae ni, kotoba wo tatematsuri, kansha no makoto wo sasagu.

translated_text: At the beginning of the new year, we worship the eight million deities and pray for household safety, business prosperity, physical health, and fulfillment of wishes.
original_text: 新年の初めに、八百万の神々を祭り、家内安全、商売繁盛、身体健康、諸願成就を祈る。
title: Shogatsu (New Year) Prayer
transliteration: Shinnen no hajime ni, yaoyorozu no kamyo wo mairi, kanai anzen, shōbai hanjō, shintai kenkō, shogan jōjuku wo inoru.

translated_text: We worship the Seven Lucky Gods and pray for long life, good fortune, and great prosperity.
original_text: 七福神を祭り、福寿長久、開運招福、大業繁盛を祈る。
title: Shichi Fukujin (Seven Lucky Gods)
transliteration: Shichi Fukujin wo mairi, fukuju chōkyū, kaiun shōfuku, daigyō hanjō wo inoru.

translated_text: At the start of the year, visiting the shrine for the first time, praying for a year of happiness.
original_text: 年の初め、初めて神宮に参拝し、一年の幸を祈る。
title: Hatsumode (First Shrine Visit)
transliteration: Toshi no hajime, hajimete jingu ni sanpai shi, ichinen no shiawase wo inoru.

translated_text: The gods descend from heaven, dwell on earth, and reside among human beings.
original_text: 神は天より降り、地に宿り、人の間に居り給ふ。
title: Kami ga Mairu (The Gods Come)
transliteration: Kami wa ama kori, tsuchi ni yadori, hito no aida ni iri tamau.
